_contract: training_features in champion.churn_prediction defines the exact column order for inference. It is written by scripts/train_models.py at training time. The ChurnPredictor reads it from here. The API passes the full 56-feature dict; ChurnPredictor._dict_to_vector() extracts only training_features. Never hard-code feature names. A mismatch between training and inference column order produces silently wrong predictions.
